steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Finally, Super Lion discovers the true identity of Starzilla, and asks why it deceived her when she clearly treated it as a friend.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "I'm sorry, Super Lion, but this is my nature. I was born to wreak havoc."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Super Lion was heartbroken, but for the whole city's sake, she finally mustered the resolve to fight the monster one last time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Super Lion, this is the final battle."

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: "Surrender, Starzilla! I don't want to hurt my friend!"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "The plan to destroy Super Lion will be realized today!"

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: "Bring it on! I'm the guardian of this city!"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Show me all you've got, my friend."

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: "I won't go easy on you this time."

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "How naive! Taste my cosmic wrath! Million Starbeam Laser!!!!!"
